events.body:
I noticed that the Forgot Password page on BLT-Next is not opening. When I visit the link below, it shows a 404 page instead.

Steps to reproduce:

Visit https://next.owaspblt.org/pages/forgot-password.html

The page displays a 404: page not found message.

Expected behavior:

The Forgot Password link should open the password recovery page.

Actual behavior:

The page returns a 404 error instead of opening.

This could make it difficult for users who have forgotten their passwords to find a way to recover their accounts.

I've attached a screenshot showing the issue.
![Screenshot 2026-11-10 004410.png](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
events.title: Forgot Password page returns 404
